title: Operations Specialist - SAP Integration, Event Mesh & AI
text:
Company Description
Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.
Job Description
SAP Integration Suite (CPI):

Proficiency in CPI deployment, configuration, and custom adapter setups

Expertise in monitoring integration flows (iFlows) and message processing

Strong understanding of security management and credentials configuration

Advanced knowledge of Integration Suite capability administration within BTP

Familiarity with user roles, authorizations, and cockpit connectivity

Proficiency in Cloud Connector and hybrid connectivity aspects

PI/PO NetWeaver Admin:

Expertise in SLD management and CTS+ transport operations

Understanding of Integration Directory (ID) and ESR components

Performance tuning on OS and NetWeaver Application levels

NetWeaver Java stack administration and troubleshooting skills

Familiarity with handling Security Notes and firewall routing processes

Advanced Event Mesh & Event Hub:

Proficiency in event-driven architecture and broker configuration

Queue management, pub/sub messaging, and topic routing taxonomies

Monitoring Event Mesh, message VPNs, and client profiles

Cloud Application Event Hub setup and event distribution

Familiarity with broker clustering and high availability setups

API Management:

API design, lifecycle management, and portal administration

Configuring security policies (OAuth, API Keys) and traffic control

Policy custom scripting, routing, and payload transformation

API gateway monitoring, analytics, and custom dashboards

AI Core & AI Launchpad:

Deploying, managing, and monitoring pipelines via AI Core

Resource group configuration, secret handling, and Git integration

Orchestration, scaling, and serving machine learning models

Familiarity with Generative AI Hub and foundation models

BTP Operations & Platform Admin:

BTP Cockpit administration, subaccounts, and directories

Entitlement allocation, service assignments, and quota management

BTP security, Identity Authentication Service (IAS), and custom IdPs

Destination management, service keys, and binding configurations

Enhanced Skills:

Stay updated with SAP BTP, Event Mesh, and AI Core advancements

Integrating SAP with third-party apps, brokers, and AI services

Troubleshooting complex integration, routing, and ML pipeline issues

Bridge technical operations with cross-functional development teams

Security, compliance, and governance in hybrid SAP environments

Familiarity with Edge Integration Cell implementations
Qualifications
Educational qualification:
MCA/BE/B-Tech
Experience :
7-10 years
Mandatory/requires Skills :

SAP Integration CPI, Advanced Event Mesh & AI-Core
Preferred Skills :

SAP Integration CPI, Advanced Event Mesh & AI-Core
Additional Information
Production & Integration Recovery: Proven expertise in resolving complex failures across CPI integrations, Advanced Event Mesh streams, and AI pipelines.

Execution under Pressure: Ability to prioritize and execute critical tasks under pressure to meet tight deadlines in fast-paced operational landscapes.

Self-Direction & Architectural Judgment: Strong capacity for independent decision-making, taking ownership of hybrid BTP environments with minimal oversight.

Global Cross-Functional Collaboration: Exceptional communication skills to align multi-regional teams across legacy PI, modern Integration Suite, and upcoming AI/Event initiatives.

Continuous Tech Innovation: High learning agility and commitment to mastering emerging BTP services, including AI Core, event-driven architecture, and automation
